meta.title: Cuelith · Live projection software, lightweight and modular
meta.description: Cuelith puts lyrics, texts and announcements on the projector, the stage monitor and every other screen. Free and open source, it starts light and grows with the plugins you need.

hero.eyebrow: Live projection software · free and open source
hero.title: Live projection that starts light and grows with you.
hero.lead: Cuelith puts texts, lyrics and announcements on the projector, the stage monitor and every other screen. The core does a few things and does them well; you add the rest with plugins, only if you need it.
hero.shotAlt: The same text on three screens: the projector in the room, the Cuelith control view and the remote on a phone.

pillars.title: Three choices, taken all the way

items.title: Install only what you use
items.text: Out of the box, Cuelith is an essential tool: playlist, slides, preview, program and outputs. Songs, protocols and tools are plugins you switch on and off without restarting.

items.title: The screen stays on
items.text: Every plugin runs in its own separate space, with only the permissions it declares. If one stops responding, it is restarted automatically and the projection carries on. Your show is saved safely and recovered after a crash.

items.title: Free, with no surprises
items.text: The app is open source and needs no account. It works offline, and your shows, songs and images stay on your computer.

features.title: Built for the person at the desk, even working alone

rows.title: Always see what is on air and what comes next
rows.text: Playlist on the left, slides in the middle, program and preview on the right. One click prepares, one key goes live, with the fade you choose.
points: Five layouts: for presenting, for bands, for conferences
Keyboard shortcuts for everything: next, back, blackout, song sections
Timer and messages for the people on stage
rows.alt: Cuelith control view with playlist, slides, program and preview.

rows.title: One piece of content, a different screen for each audience
rows.text: Press “Next” once. The room gets large text over the background; the stage gets the text, the next slide, the clock and messages from the desk.
points: As many outputs as your computer can connect
Blackout and freeze on a single output, leaving the others alone
Backgrounds per slide, per item or by default, with a dim layer for legibility
rows.alt: Two outputs with the same content: the room shows the text over a background, the stage shows the text with the next slide and the clock.

rows.title: Songs with sections, ready for a band that improvises
rows.text: Verse, Chorus and Bridge become large buttons: when the band goes back to the chorus, you are there in one tap. Songs import and export in the open OpenLyrics and ChordPro formats.
points: Libraries searchable by title, lyrics, author and number
Projection order kept separate from the lyrics
Credits and authors always in place
rows.alt: Band layout: song sections as large buttons.

rows.title: As a team, with tablet and phone
rows.text: On the same network, a tablet becomes a second control desk and a phone becomes the speaker's remote. It opens in the browser, with nothing to install, and pairs with a code.
points: Different roles: operator, remote, view only
Works offline, on the venue network alone
Every device can be revoked with one click
rows.alt: The remote on a phone: slide on air, next slide, Back and Next.

rows.title: Know in advance whether the computer can cope
rows.text: An indicator shows how much the app and the active plugins use, at rest, now and at peak, compared with what your computer actually has.
points: Frames per second for every output
Usage for every plugin, declared and measured
One colour to watch: green, yellow, red

items.title: Conferences and schools
items.text: A running order of talks, notes, a timer with time colours and messages to the speaker.

items.title: Concerts and bands
items.text: Sections as buttons, projection order, lyrics and next slide on stage.

items.title: Churches and communities
items.text: Songs with sections, announcements, texts and backgrounds. One monitor for the musicians and one for the speaker.

items.title: Live streaming and events
items.text: Camera, scenes, lower thirds and streaming will arrive as plugins, on the same app.

plugins.title: The core does little. You choose the rest.
plugins.lead: Every plugin installs from inside the app, declares what it can do before you switch it on, and can be turned off at any time. Some add a tool to the control view; others work in the background, like audio and video protocols.

permissions.none: Asks for no permissions: no internet, no files
permissions.storage: Saves its data on your computer
permissions.native: Native program, with full access to the computer

plugins.soonNote: Coming plugins are planned, with no promised date. When they are released they appear here and in the app.

developers.title: Want to write one?
developers.text: The plugin system is open: anyone can add a tool, a protocol or a layout. The source code includes an example plugin to start from. Cuelith is free software, but your plugin is yours: you choose its licence, free or paid, open or closed.

plugins.marketplaceLink: See every plugin in the marketplace

download.title: Ready in two minutes
download.lead: Free, with no sign-up. Updates arrive on their own and install only when you decide, never while you are on air.
notes: Windows may ask for confirmation on first launch, because the app is new and does not have a paid signature yet: choose “More info”, then “Run anyway”.
You do not need to be an administrator of the computer.
8 GB of memory recommended. Integrated graphics are enough for text and images.

versions.title: All versions
versions.lead: Every version stays available, with its notes.
versions.empty: The list of versions is not available right now. The download above always gives you the latest one.

items.a: Yes. The app is open source and will stay free, along with everything you need to use it. Today all plugins are free too.

items.q: Who can use and modify the source code?
items.a: Anyone. Cuelith is free software under the GPL: you can study it, change it and share it. If you distribute a modified version, you must share its source code under the same licence, so Cuelith stays free for everyone. Plugins are separate programs: their authors choose their own licence. The name “Cuelith” and the logo remain the project’s.

In the future some advanced plugins may have a price, which we intend to keep low. That will not apply to anything essential for using Cuelith: the app and its core features stay free. If it happens, we will say so clearly beforehand.
Yes. The internet is only needed to download updates and new plugins. During an event Cuelith does not need it, not even for devices on the local network.

items.q: Can I use it for live streaming?
items.a: Not yet. Today Cuelith projects texts, songs and images on multiple screens. Camera, scenes and streaming are the next planned plugins.
It stays on your computer. Cuelith has no accounts and sends no personal data or content. It connects to the internet only to check for updates and read the list of plugins.

items.q: I already have my songs. Can I import them?
items.a: Yes, if they are in the open OpenLyrics or ChordPro formats, or as plain text. You can also export them all at once, as a backup.
Windows 10 or 11, or Linux, 64-bit. With one slide on air Cuelith uses about 600 MB of memory; each extra output adds about 120. The app itself shows you how much it is using.

items.q: Which languages is the app available in?
items.a: English and Italian, both included. At first launch Cuelith follows the language of your computer, and you can change it in Settings → General. More languages will arrive as plugins.

items.q: What happens if a plugin has a problem?
items.a: It is closed and restarted automatically, while the projection carries on. If it stops several times in a row it stays off and tells you.

footer.privacy: The site uses no cookies and does not track visitors. Only the form to propose a plugin loads an anti-spam check from Cloudflare (Turnstile), which may store data in your browser.

support.title: Cuelith is free
support.text: No ads, no accounts. If it helps you, you can support its development with a small donation.
support.note: It is optional: Cuelith stays free for everyone.

meta.title: Plugin marketplace · Cuelith
meta.description: Cuelith plugins: what they do, what they can access and how to get them. Free and paid.

marketplace.title: Add to Cuelith what you need
marketplace.leadFree: Plugins from the project and from other authors. Every card says what the plugin does and what it can access, before you install it.
marketplace.leadMixed: Free and paid plugins, from the project and from other authors. Every card says what the plugin does, what it costs and what it can access, before you install it.
marketplace.install: Install it from Cuelith: Plugins → Marketplace.
marketplace.affiliateNote: The link may contain a referral reference of the Cuelith project.
marketplace.notBuyable: Not available to buy right now
marketplace.empty: The marketplace cannot be reached right now. Please try again later.

how.title: How buying works
items: The plugin is sold by its author, from their own store at a registered reseller that handles payment, VAT and refunds. Cuelith does not collect any money and never sees your payment details.
Some purchase links may contain a referral reference of the Cuelith project, which supports the project this way. The price you pay is the store's price.
After buying you receive a key by email. You enter it in Cuelith, on the plugin's card: it works on 3 computers at once and you can move it when you change computer.
If the store refunds you, the licence switches off by itself.

authors.title: Do you write plugins?
authors.text: You can propose yours, free or paid, without creating an account.

meta.title: Propose a plugin · Cuelith
meta.description: How to publish a plugin, free or paid, in the Cuelith marketplace: rules, checklist and submission form.

submit.title: Propose your plugin
submit.lead: One form, no account. The project reviews the plugin and, if everything is in order, publishes it in the Cuelith marketplace.

items.title: Write and package
items.text: Start from the plugin template and follow the developer guide. The package (.cpkg) must sit at a stable https address.

items.title: Fill in the form
items.text: Description, package, licence and, for a paid plugin, the details of your store.

items.title: We review
items.text: We check the package, the permissions and the checklist. We reply to the address you give.

items.title: Publication
items.text: If the proposal is approved, the plugin appears in the marketplace on the website and inside Cuelith. Each new version is proposed again from the same form.

checklist.title: Conformity checklist
checklist.lead: To be published, the plugin must meet all of it: tick each item in the form.
checklist.paidTitle: In addition, for a paid plugin

items.noMalware: The plugin contains no malware, hidden code or undeclared data collection.
items.permissions: It declares in its manifest every permission it uses, and only those.
items.licence: It states its licence, proprietary ones (EULA) included, and where it can be read.
items.name: It does not use “Cuelith” in its own name (write “for Cuelith”) and does not copy code from the Cuelith core, which is GPL.
items.merchant: I sell it with my own store at Lemon Squeezy, which collects the payment, pays the VAT and handles refunds. The Cuelith project does not collect or touch my money.
items.devices: In the product I have turned on licence keys with a limit of 3 devices per key.
items.affiliate: I have turned on my store's affiliate programme with a {percent}% commission and I give its sign-up page below.

paid.title: Paid plugins: how selling works
paid.intro: The marketplace sells nothing: it lists the plugin and sends people to your store. Today the registered reseller we support is Lemon Squeezy.
steps: Open your store and create the plugin's product, with licence keys and a limit of 3 devices per key.

Turn on the store's affiliate programme and set the commission to {percent}%: this is the condition to be listed as paid. Your store pays the commission directly to the project, and the price for buyers does not change.
Give the affiliate sign-up page below: we enrol the project and use our own purchase link in the catalogue.
Create your author key and sign every package: in the plugin template two commands are enough (pnpm keys, pnpm sign).
paid.refunds: You handle refunds from your store: a refund switches off the licence of the person who got it.
rules: Set the licence key to never expire if you sell the plugin once: the permission in Cuelith never outlasts the key's expiry, so a one-year key stops working after a year.
Each key works on 3 computers. Whoever changes computer deactivates the old one from the plugin (Plugins → Installed → “Deactivate this computer”) and activates the new one.
If a computer breaks and cannot be deactivated, free the seat yourself from your store (Lemon Squeezy: License keys → the key → activations): buyers must be able to contact you.
After a refund the key is deactivated and the plugin, at the next check, switches off outside live shows: nothing is ever stopped during a live show.

form.title: The form

id.label: Identifier
id.hint: In reverse-domain form, for example acme.lyrics-pro. Lowercase letters, numbers, dots and hyphens only. “cuelith” and “core” are reserved for the project.

description.label: Description
description.hint: What it does, in one or two sentences (10 to 300 characters).

publisher.label: Author or company
publisher.hint: The name shown on the card.

license.label: Plugin licence
license.hint: A licence name (for example MIT) or the name of your own terms of use (EULA).

eulaUrl.label: Where the licence or EULA can be read (optional)

packageUrl.label: Package address (.cpkg)
packageUrl.hint: https, stable and reachable by anyone. We check size, fingerprint and permissions.

repositoryUrl.label: Project page (optional)
repositoryUrl.hint: The plugin's website or repository, an https address.

authorKey.label: Author's public key
authorKey.hint: 43 characters. It signs your packages: required for a paid plugin, optional for a free one.

signature.label: Package signature
signature.hint: 86 characters, printed by “pnpm sign”. Required if you give the author's key.

price.label: Price to show
price.hint: Free text, for example “€9”. The real price is set in your store.

checkoutUrl.label: Purchase page of the product
checkoutUrl.hint: The product's address in your store (lemonsqueezy.com domain).

affiliateUrl.label: Affiliate sign-up page of your store
affiliateUrl.hint: We join as affiliates and use our own link in the catalogue (lemonsqueezy.com domain).

storeId.label: Store number
storeId.hint: You can find it in your store settings.

productId.label: Product number
productId.hint: You can find it on the product page.

contact.label: Your email
contact.hint: Only used to reply to you. It is never published.

form.privacy: Your email is only used to reply to you and is never published. We keep it until the proposal is decided and in any case no longer than 60 days. The form uses an anti-spam check from Cloudflare (Turnstile), which may store data in your browser.
form.needsScript: The form needs JavaScript to be turned on.

result.ok: Proposal received. We will reply to the address you gave.
result.unavailable: The service is not available right now. Please try again later.
result.network: I cannot send the proposal: check your connection and try again.
result.captcha: I cannot verify that you are a person. Reload the page and try again.
result.rate: You have already sent several proposals today. Please try again tomorrow.

errors.notHttps: The address must start with https://.
errors.notShop: It must be an address of your store (lemonsqueezy.com).
errors.invalidId: Invalid format: lowercase reverse-domain, for example acme.lyrics-pro.
errors.reservedId: This name is reserved for the project.
errors.invalidKey: Invalid key: it must be 43 characters (letters, numbers, - and _).
errors.notInteger: A whole number greater than zero is needed.
errors.mustConfirm: To propose the plugin you need to tick the whole checklist.
errors.invalidSignature: Invalid signature: it must be 86 characters (letters, numbers, - and _).
